title: These dish towels are good for show but are not absorbent for dish drying and they wrinkle and shrink after washing and drying
text:
These dish towels are good for show but are not absorbent for dish drying and they wrinkle and shrink after washing and drying. These dish towels are good for show but are not absorbent for dish drying. Water almost runs off them. In addition, they are not all the same size. As you can see from the first photo, one towel was about a half inch longer than the other two.

They shrink from 18" x 28" inches to 16" x 27" after washing and drying. They also wrinkle (see third photo) and need to be hand pressed to return them to that "like new" look.

The towels are pretty and have three separate designs as you can see from the second photo. However, they are not useful as dish drying towels. From an aesthetic perspective, these get five stars. From a practical perspective, these three towels get one star--hence the three-star rating.
